title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Saving twice in a row no longer loses the file
summary: Two scans of one file can overlap when a second save arrives mid parse. Each wrote its result, then every scan the watcher thought outdated erased the entry, including the one just written.

highlights.title: A file could vanish from the index while still on disk
highlights.description: The watcher now asks whether the file is deleted right now, rather than whether anything at all has happened to it. A save needs no safety net: the next scan rewrites the entry.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Driving the watcher through three thousand interleaved creations, deletions and folder removals left files on disk that the index had lost. They now match exactly.
That storm is now a test, and restoring the previous guard fails it.
